thread:
jia: Quick RFC follow-up — looked at rollout metadata shipped last week. Main question: keep per-tenant pin as opaque string or split into binding + affinity?
sam: +1 split. Opaque pins hide tenant vs global intent.
matt: Splitting increases client surface. Need compatibility shims or schema versioning.
jia: Proposal: keep pin string as canonical v1, add optional binding and affinity objects in v2. Precedence: binding > pin string > rollout hint.
nina: Can TTL live in binding? Current pin_ttl is a flat int that leaks ops semantics.
kevin: TTL needed for eviction. If in binding, make it nullable and add ttl_policy enum {INHERIT, SOFT, HARD}.
jia: Example shape idea: { "pin":"model:abc123", "binding":{ "scope":"tenant", "target":"model:abc123", "ttl":3600, "ttl_policy":"SOFT" }, "affinity":{ "weight":0.8, "fallbacks":["model:abc122","model:abc120"] }}
sam: Fallbacks good. Keep ordering deterministic and cap length.
matt: Decide if affinity is honored only on overload or always. Some customers forbid implicit swaps.
nina: UX idea: add enforcement on binding (REQUIRED, PREFERRED, OPTIONAL). REQUIRED = hard pin, PREFERRED = best-effort, OPTIONAL = advisory.
kevin: If REQUIRED, scheduler must ensure capacity or reject — control plane needs quota checks.
jia: Implementation plan: Stage A accept old pin string and new objects with precedence. Stage B emit schema_version and validate clients when >=v2. Stage C update Console and SDKs.
sam: For Stage A, add compatibility table in RFC: examples for pin-only, binding-only, both.
matt: Tradeoff: JSON vs protobuf. Keep JSON API, consider protobuf internally once schema_version exists.
nina: Agrees; protobuf internally gives typed validation without breaking clients.
kevin: Telemetry must record resolution path. Add resolved_via in traces.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: New schema changes must pass CI job rollout-schema-check.
jia: Action items: I will draft v2 schema with enforcement/ttl_policy/affinity and compatibility rules; @sam will add examples; @kevin will spec quota reactions; @matt will list SDK migration notes.
sam: Bikeshed: naming — binding vs pin_object? Binding communicates intent, prefer binding.
matt: +1 binding. Add lint rule: fallbacks unique and limited to 5 entries.
nina: I'll mock UI after draft.
jia: Thanks all — drafting now. :rocket:
